theme: The Denial Came First - Volume II
title: Applause Is Not an Audit

scenes.text: A big announcement. Hundreds of likes. Dozens of comments. Every visible comment is congratulations.
Everyone applauds everyone. Everyone “counts on” everyone. It’s a warm room. Warm rooms are great for cheering. Less so for scrutiny.
An industry that regulates itself, congratulates itself, and replies to complaints with a link to the right form.
